name: Microsoft Office Documents & Automation
description: Read and write Word, Excel and PowerPoint files and drive Microsoft Project schedules directly from AI agents. Document operations are pure file-format library calls and work without Office installed; the COM lifecycle tools require Office on Windows.
capabilities: Create, read and edit Word documents (.docx)
Read and write Excel workbooks and sheets (.xlsx)
Manage Microsoft Project tasks, resources and baselines
Launch, show and quit Office applications over COM
